content: models.dev/api.json: providers keyed by id with {id,name,env,npm,api,doc,models}; each model {id,name,family,tool_call,reasoning,modalities,limit{context,output},cost{input,output,cache_read,cache_write,reasoning} in USD per 1M tokens,open_weights,release_date}. Common practice: commit a snapshot, refresh with a bounded network fetch. LiteLLM model_prices json and OpenRouter /models pricing are alternatives; Codex SDK Usage {input_tokens,cached_input_tokens,cache_write_input_tokens,output_tokens}; Agent SDK result modelUsage[model]{inputTokens,outputTokens,cacheReadInputTokens,cacheCreationInputTokens,webSearchRequests,costUSD} + total_cost_usd (cumulative per query, estimate).
